testCase:
F-12: A line present and a line absent
Goal: Download the 9 October 2026 log and check that it shows the declined card for order 4471 but no cache miss for user 42.
STEP 1: Navigate to /sandbox/f-12/
STEP 2: Click "Download log"
STEP 3: Verify "Saved app-2026-10-09.log (7 lines)" is visible
STEP 4: Verify the downloaded file "app-2026-10-09.log" contains the line "ERROR payment: card declined for order 4471"
STEP 5: Verify the downloaded file "app-2026-10-09.log" does not contain the text "cache: miss key=user:42"
